# CXNM - Standard - WIN - D - Passwordless

Hides the password field at sign-in, so that users use Windows Hello or a security key instead of typing their password.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0 — SC - Credential Management - D - Passwordless |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Passwordless.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Passwordless.json) |
